stories.title: Week 4 NFL Power Rankings, plus every team's fantasy surprise
stories.summary: How do all 32 NFL teams stack up through three weeks of the season? Plus, we picked out each team's biggest fantasy surprise -- good or bad.

stories.title: Seven things Solak thinks: Brock Bowers is JSN, Rams need one more trade, more
stories.summary: The Rams need another pass catcher? Get ready for Week 4 with some takes.

stories.title: Senate greenlights Protect College Sports Act with 77-22 vote
stories.summary: The Protect College Sports Act, a federal bill aimed at reshaping the industry, took a step toward to becoming law Monday when the U.S. Senate voted 77-22 to pass it, with Ted Cruz saying, "This bill puts an end to the chaos plaguing college athletics."

stories.title: QB3 Keenum's 'extraordinary' effort lifts Bears over Eagles
stories.summary: In his first NFL start in 1,009 days, Chicago third-string quarterback Case Keenum, 38, led the Bears to a dominant 27-7 victory over the perennial NFC heavyweight Philadelphia Eagles on Monday, a performance coach Ben Johnson labeled "extraordinary."

stories.title: Sirianni rues reaction to flagged hit on Hurts in Eagles' MNF loss
stories.summary: After a 27-7 loss to Chicago on Monday, Eagles coach Nick Sirianni expressed "remorse" over his reaction to a sideline hit by Bears linebacker D'Marco Jackson on Philadelphia's Jalen Hurts that temporarily knocked his quarterback out of the first half.
